title: Cancel a third of your recurring meetings and see what breaks
excerpt: Most standing meetings outlive the problem they were created for. A two-week experiment that costs nothing.
content:
Most standing meetings outlive the problem they were created for. A two-week experiment that costs nothing.

Why it happens

Habits form around what is easy to measure. Revenue, headcount and the number of projects under way are all visible on a dashboard; the cost of complexity is not. So it grows, quietly, until someone goes looking for it.

What to do about it

Start small. Pick one product line, one customer segment or one week of the calendar and look at it honestly. The first pass does not need to be precise to be useful: being roughly right about where the effort goes is enough to change the conversation.

If you would like a second pair of eyes, we are happy to talk it through.
